agent_report.summary:
Run-002 begins from an empty specimen: main carries infrastructure and docs only, with run-001's product code deliberately reverted. There were no open PRs to review, no blocked Issues, and no Issues in flight, so work in flight was 0 of the limit of 1.

I created a single Issue, #12, the foundation for the daily planner: today's view with up to 3 priorities and unbounded tasks, complete/un-complete, guarded delete, localStorage persistence across reload, 360px with no horizontal scroll, and keyboard operability. It is labelled ready, which puts work in flight at the limit, so nothing further was created.

Three requirements were added over run-001's equivalent Issue, based on what that run cost. The GitHub Pages constraint is now explicit (index.html at the repository root, relative asset paths) because the site is served from a subpath. Measured WCAG AA contrast ratios must appear in the PR description, since the external reviewer found real contrast failures on run-001's first pass. CI must publish a browser-evidence artifact with 360px and 1280px screenshots, because visual quality is a Definition of Done item and that artifact is the Queen's only way to see the app. The Issue also requires DECISIONS.md to record the storage key and schema shape with its migration story, the file layout, and the test-runner choice.

DONE was not declared: with no product code on main, nearly every Definition of Done item is unmet.
